curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Having already spent a fortune they were promised, three half-brothers suddenly discover the inheritance is gone—leaving them to fix the mess together.
curatedMovie.description: Reunited at their mother's funeral, three estranged half-brothers learn they have inherited a fortune. After blowing the cash in advance, they discover the windfall is not coming, forcing them to regroup.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Funny, approachable, and lightly touching. A steady French comedy of errors built around instant family chaos.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: A breezy 1990s French comedy where financial panic turns into genuine family warmth, mixing farcical mishaps with sharp sibling chemistry.
